mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair atorvastatin metabolism and increase myopathy/rhabdomyolysis risk; both drugs independently increase muscle toxicity risk.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; consider temporary discontinuation of atorvastatin during amphotericin B therapy or use liposomal formulation of amphotericin B to reduce nephrotoxicity; monitor for muscle symptoms.
